name: WaveUI-25k
notes: The card describes this as a subset of a collection of about 80k preprocessed examples built from WebUI, RoboFlow website screenshots and GroundUI-18K, filtered for duplicates, overlaps, low quality and many text elements, with added annotation fields. The publisher's agentsea/wave-ui dataset (Wave UI) has the same 13 fields and 79,412 rows across three splits; the 25k card does not name it, so the component link rests on that match. Dataset-viewer statistics over 12,493 of the rows (partial) show platform values web, desktop and mobile and source labels including roboflow, webui, mind2web_test_*, omniact, motif, screenspot and agent_studio. The repository declares no license, and the source datasets' terms are not inferred.
summary: A 24,978-example subset of an ~80k UI element collection, pairing screenshots and instructions with target boxes and annotated element names, descriptions, types, OCR, purposes and click expectations.
